title: Verify v1 acceptance criteria
lead: Run each v1 acceptance criterion (C15-C19) end to end and record the result.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** new features; fixes, which become their own slices.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: PROJECT.md defines v1 by five acceptance criteria. This slice is the gate.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- An acceptance check script or test target (path per the scaffolding layout).
- Golden fixtures for the imp vs dwarf seed 1 result and replay hash.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - One automated check per criterion that fails until the criterion holds.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- C15: compare the spec's opcode, modifier and mode list against the test enumeration.
- C16: run `arena run imp.s dwarf.s --seed 1` and compare result and replay hash to the golden fixture.
- C17: run the malformed-input and round-trip suites.
- C18: run the 100-seed starter-bot tournament twice and diff.
- C19: play the shared replay in both viewers and compare frame models.
- Gap: "every run and machine" in C16 needs runs on more than one machine; with no CI host chosen, record which machines were used.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The acceptance script passes.
- A note on this item lists each criterion with its command and outcome.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-acceptance` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
